race.description: Club Forbes Showcase Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: CASTERLY ROCK (6) is another perennial placegetter who caught the eye late in the piece when third over this distance at Warren last time out. Enjoys an economical run out of gate one and should be in the finish again. COMMANDO JACK (12) raced on the speed and only tired in the dying stages over this trip at Dubbo recently. Heading the right way and should be ready to peak at the third run back. CHEAP SHOT (7) made a late charge but failed by under a length over today's journey at Dubbo last start. Racing in great heart and should be about the money once more. COOL AS POPEYE (15) caught the eye last start at Wagga when skipping through the slop late to grab third. Fitter and drawn kinder. Not dismissing.
